findings.finding: The implemented replay is another empty-body create request, not replay of the complete stored or exported M56 record required by the product brief. There is no download action or exported-record contract, and no test mutates exported evidence, lineage, arithmetic, factor, method, implementation, classification or hash fields before replay.
findings.evidence: workspace-api.ts sends body {} to /calculate/replay; routes.ts calls the same calculateBill store method; CompanyWorkspaceDemo.tsx exposes replay but no download; workspace-api.test.ts tests only create and one display mutation.
findings.required_repair: Implement a bounded export/download and replay contract that accepts the complete record, reauthorizes lineage, recomputes exact hashes and arithmetic, requires full equality, and rejects systematic mutations without replacing stored history.

findings.finding: Required immutable lineage is incomplete in the persisted/public contract. No canonical bill-version payload hash is bound. Actor and calculation creation time exist in database columns but are omitted from the returned record, decoder and UI; the claimed calculation timestamp is not displayed.
findings.evidence: The adapter BINDING_KEYS and input_snapshot omit a version payload hash; SyntheticDraftCalculation and readBill omit created_by/created_at; the UI renders no timestamp.
findings.required_repair: Add and verify the canonical reviewed-version payload hash, actor and creation time throughout storage, response, decoder, replay and visible lineage.

findings.finding: The browser decoder validates selected values but is not an exact record validator. It does not enforce exact nested keys and complete values for gas records, trace expressions and units, total rounding, or reconciliation authority/explanation, and it only checks input/result hashes for hexadecimal shape instead of recomputing them.
findings.evidence: decodeSyntheticBill checks gas mass and selected CO2e values, trace step/result pairs and hash regexes; arbitrary extra nested fields, altered units/expressions/rounding/explanations and lying 64-character hashes are not rejected by those predicates.
findings.required_repair: Bind exact nested key sets and every material value, recompute canonical input/result hashes or compare to independently trusted pinned values, and add internally consistent fabrication tests.

findings.finding: Calculation and replay routes map every engine/store/database exception to HTTP 409 Review the bill before calculating. Required timeout, malformed engine output and database failures must return bounded HTTP 503 No result produced; unreviewed evidence currently returns 422 rather than its specified review-required 409.
findings.evidence: Both route catch blocks unconditionally return REVIEW_CONFLICT with 409. No injected private-detail, engine failure, timeout or database rollback route test exists.
findings.required_repair: Use typed finite error mapping, add bounded 503 failure paths with private-detail exclusion, and distinguish invalid body from valid but unreviewed/stale state.

findings.finding: The claimed database acceptance is not demonstrated. The 18-test/109-assertion database run never creates an M56 calculation or calls the new writer. It adds the tables only to generic RLS/read/update/delete loops.
findings.evidence: No calculation or create_synthetic_bill_calculation reference appears in any database *.test.ts beyond migration/table names. Owner/admin writer success, member/direct writer denial, foreign/mixed lineage, one audit event, canonical tamper, stale inputs, atomic rollback and conflict convergence lack executable database tests.
findings.required_repair: Add direct database tests for the full M56 writer and read boundary, all roles and tenant substitutions, exact lineage and payload/hash validation, append-only behavior, one-event convergence and transactional rollback.

findings.finding: The technical idempotency contract is absent. There is no idempotency key or server-derived operation_fingerprint, so same-key/same-operation replay and same-key/different-operation conflict behavior cannot be enforced or tested.
findings.evidence: The calculate and replay bodies must be empty and the database schema has no idempotency key or fingerprint. Only identical local requests and the activity/method uniqueness constraint are exercised.
findings.required_repair: Implement the documented server-derived fingerprint and bounded idempotency-key semantics, or revise and independently approve the contract before review.
